subject.title: fix(browser): prove post-action target continuity before adopting a tab

question: Should OpenClaw accept the PR's bounded resolver heuristics, or require the canonical backend-owned target-outcome design before changing this shared browser identity contract?
rationale: The remaining defect is not a mechanical test gap: it depends on the permanent ownership boundary for target identity across several browser backends, and the contributor has explicitly requested direction before expanding scope.

options.title: Require backend-owned outcomes
options.body: Have operations return the exact acted-on target or a closed/stale outcome, removing route-level replacement discovery across affected backends.

options.title: Accept bounded heuristics
options.body: Merge the current resolver approach while explicitly accepting that unique new-target and unique URL matches are continuity assumptions rather than identity guarantees.

recommendation.title: Require backend-owned outcomes
recommendation.body: Have operations return the exact acted-on target or a closed/stale outcome, removing route-level replacement discovery across affected backends.

likelyOwner.reason: The active canonical report supplies the proposed ownership boundary and regression matrix, making this person the strongest available routing candidate for the design choice.
